summary: community.general 12 breaking changes: mh.base debug always delegates to AnsibleModule, oneview utils no longer import os, and slack prepend_hash defaults to never.
questions: What is the default of prepend_hash in community.general.slack now?
Why did my slack channel lose its leading # after upgrading?

answer_card.title: community.general breaking changes (13.0.0)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `mh.base` module utils: `debug` is always delegated to the underlying `AnsibleModule`.
- `oneview` module utils: no longer import standard library `os`.
- `slack`: `prepend_hash` default changed from `auto` to **`never`**; set it explicitly if you relied on the old behavior.
